# FastSearch MCP v0.5.1
Lightning-fast Windows file search via direct NTFS Master File Table access. FastMCP 3.2 server with sampling, CodeMode, prompts, skills, direct REST API bridge, and dedicated SOTA search page.

## Quick Start
```bash
uvx fastsearch-mcp
# Or with agentic discovery:
uvx fastsearch-mcp --agentic
```

## Interactive Webapp & Dedicated Search UI
- Webapp Frontend: `http://localhost:10844` (`/search` page)
- FastAPI REST Bridge: `http://localhost:10845` (`/api/search`, `/api/service/*`, `/api/file`)

## Core Tools
- `fastsearch_search(pattern, path, search_all, max_results)` — Name pattern search via direct MFT
- `fastsearch_search_advanced(...)` — MFT search with size/date/attribute filters
- `file_content_search(search_pattern, search_dir, ...)` — Regex content search in files
- `service_status_fastsearch` — Check FastSearch Windows service and pipe health
- `service_start_fastsearch` / `service_stop_fastsearch` — Control service execution
- `drive_inventory` — List all drives
- `analyze_disk_usage(path, max_depth)` — Disk space analysis
- `find_duplicate_files(directories, pattern, min_size)` — Duplicates by hash

## Architecture
Python FastMCP 3.2 bridge & FastAPI REST bridge (port 10845) ↔ Named pipe `\\.\pipe\FastSearchMCP` ↔ C++ Windows engine (LocalSystem SCM or interactive `--standalone` mode) ↔ Live NTFS MFT

## Prompts (FastMCP 3.2)
- `search_files_guide` — How to search files
- `disk_analysis_guide` — Disk usage and duplicate analysis
- `service_troubleshooting` — Service issue resolution

## Skills (FastMCP 3.2)
- `find_recently_modified_files` — Files changed in last 7 days
- `cleanup_disk_space` — Identify large/old/duplicate files
- `forensic_file_audit` — Audit for compliance review
